en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, that he said: We were told by Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Muhammed bin Abi ‘Umayr, from Hamza bin Hamran, that he said: Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, said:
Indeed, the one who answers in all he is asked, is surely insane.
